connectors.name: AnimeUnity
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.2.14: streams fully variant-gated again (script read of window.downloadUrl + SUB_ITA/ITA marker chain + {variant} where-filter): a Sub request can never be served the Italian audio and vice versa. The 0.2.12/0.2.13 HLS route played but could not separate the two audios (the app resolves sub and dub for every title), which is why (ITA) titles still played Italian under Sub. Script-text extraction pending on-device verification.

connectors.name: AnimeWorld
connectors.releaseNotes: 0.1.1: episode titles now show "Episodio N" (template over the source's own episode number - AnimeWorld does not publish real episode names server-side, and connectors must not invent data).
